register.labelZh: SHIP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 這些表達可以描述孩子被送到營地、家具運往新居,以及貨物運往海外。實際使用的交通工具不一定是船。；SHIP SOMEBODY OFF 可以用來談論把某人送到營地、學校、訓練地點或親戚家暫住。；SHIP SOMETHING OFF 可以描述把家具、書籍、機器、樂器和其他財物運往遠方。；當公司、工廠、倉庫或機構把人員或貨物送往另一國家或工作地點時,可以使用 SHIPSOMEBODY/SOMETHING OUT。
register.summaryEn: These expressions can describe children going to camp, furniture moving to a new home and goods travelling overseas. The transport does not have to be a ship. SHIP SOMEBODY OFF is useful when talking about a person being sent to camp, school, training or a relative’s home. SHIP SOMETHING OFF can describe sending furniture, books, machines, instruments and other belongings to a distant place. SHIP SOMEBODY/SOMETHING OUT is useful when a company, factory, warehouse or organisation sends people or goods to another country or work area.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、地點和意思。；名詞通常可以放在兩個位置;但使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,須把代名詞放在 SHIP 和 OFF/OUT 之間。；SHIP SOMEBODY OFF 通常表示把某人送到另一地方逗留一段時間。SHIPSOMEBODY/SOMETHING OFF 通常着重把人或物品運送到較遠的地方。SHIPSOMEBODY/SOMETHING OUT 則通常着重從公司、基地或國家把人或物品送往外地。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, place and meaning. A noun can often appear in either position: ship the boxes off ship off the boxes However, him, her, it and them must appear in the middle: ship him off ship it off ship them out SHIP SOMEBODY OFF often describes sending a person somewhere to stay for a period. SHIP SOMEBODY/SOMETHING OFF often focuses on transporting someone or something a long distance. SHIP SOMEBODY/SOMETHING OUT often focuses on sending them from a base, company or country to another place.
